What G2i sells

  • RLHF Pipelines: Engineers build human-feedback systems through teams embedded with clients or managed projects.
  • SFT Datasets: Supervised fine-tuning datasets (examples that teach models to produce desired responses).
  • Evaluations: Tests of model performance.
  • RL Environments: Custom training environments with evaluations and grading rules.
  • Seed Data
